facts: pgvector 0.8.7 supports exact search, HNSW, IVFFlat and iterative scans
approximate-index filtering is applied after the index scan
iterative scans are bounded and require recall/latency evidence
PostgreSQL full-text search exposes tsvector and tsquery
ts_rank and ts_rank_cd are lexical ranking functions
database filtering is an execution mechanism rather than application authorization
Qdrant documents dense and BM25 prefetch with RRF fusion
payload filters and indexes are supported
provider filter capability does not replace current application authorization
Pinecone documents full-text/dense hybrid retrieval and client-side RRF
metadata filtering narrows candidates before ranking
date-versioned API and hosted egress require contract and operational validation
